data.headline: Enterprise Architecture Manager @ ICA Group and ICA Sweden
data.about: Experienced Enterprise Architect with a demonstrated history of working in the retail industry. Strong professional skills and long experience in Enterprise Architecture Strategy, Business Development, Architecture Governance and Organization, Architecture Leadership and Coaching. Experience of driving architecture functions in large organizations with several parallel transformation programs,  ambitious customer experience and omni-channel agenda.

subComponents.title: Enterprise Architecture Manager @ ICA Group and ICA Sweden
subComponents.caption: Jan 2024 - Present · 2 yrs

description.text: Enterprise Architect Manager with responsibility for the architecture capability within ICA Group and ICA Sweden. As part of the Digital Strategy team I'm driving the architecture practice throughout the organization pushing the digitalization agenda to meet ICAs long-term strategic ambitions. This includes governance of digital transformation initiatives, AI and data strategy development, setting the ICA Architecture framework, WoW in digitalization processes and coaching architects as well as stakeholders in the architecture practice.

subComponents.title: Manager Enterprise Architecture & IT-Strategy at ICA Sweden
subComponents.caption: Apr 2023 - Jan 2024 · 9 mos

description.text: Chief Enterprise Architect with responsibility for the architecture and IT-strategic function within ICA Sweden. Driving the architecture practice throughout the organization pushing the digitalization agenda to meet ICAs long-term strategic ambitions with short-term plans.

Leading Enterprise Architecture processes and activities cross the different organizations within ICA Group with a strong target towards the Group strategies and omni-channel retail. 

Involved in business development initiatives to evolve the operating model for the ICA ecosystem, creating a data driven business as well as automating operations. Supporting ICA Sweden in closing the strategy-to-execution gap for customer journeys related to store and online as well as meal solutions. 

Driving activities to further develop the Enterprise Architecture practice in the Group with the aim of evolving the business development capability for our digitalization journey.

experiences.title: Enterprise Architect Afound - New Business - H&M Group
experiences.subtitle: Afound . undefined
experiences.caption: Jan 2018 - Jan 2020 · 2 yrs

description.text: As Enterprise Architect for Afound (a company within H&M Group) I worked in our business development efforts focusing on the IT and information architecture being fit for purpose according to the business and IT strategies. Afound is operating two different business models (Marketplace Operator and Multichannel Retailer) which strongly influences the IT architecture and the business development. Mirakl marketplace platform, Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO/Retail and EPI Server being the main applications in the IT landscape. Largest initiative during 2019 was to change the platform for European expansion.

subComponents.title: Head of Architecture Online Sales & Marketing H&M Group
subComponents.caption: Dec 2010 - Jan 2018 · 7 yrs 1 mo

description.text:
As Head of Architecture for the Online and Marketing Business at H&M Group I lead a team of 8-12 Enterprise Architects throughout the organisation in the IT-modernization and global expansion efforts for the H&M brand as well as the other brands COS, Weekday, Monki, & Other Stories, Arket, Cheap Monday. Throughout the years I had architects in the team leading some of the major digital transformation programs at H&M Group as well as many larger projects. The common thread over the years has been digital commerce and customer experience centric architecture on a global scale at the same time doing major transitions and modernization in the IT landscape.

Major initiatives:
- New H&M online platform and global expansion
- Decommission of legacy H&M online platform
- H&M Club - H&Ms loyalty program
- Omnichannel features: Click & Collect, Online Returns in Store, Store Stock in Mobile, ...
- New online platform for New Business brands 
- Decommission of legacy New Business Online platform
- New Contact Center platform
- Chat bot
- New PIM system for H&M brand
- New DAM system for H&M brand
- New Email Marketing platform for H&M brand covering personalized email marketing to 70 countries
- New Photostudio Operations application
- New Catalouge Production system

subComponents.title: Enterprise Architect - Supply Chain Program H&M
subComponents.caption: Feb 2009 - Dec 2010 · 1 yr 10 mos

description.text: Enterprise Architect in a transition program to change the H&M Supply Chain legacy platform to a modern SAP platform. Focus was on establishing an business risk mitigated transition approach as well as focus on Master Data Management capabilities.
Head of Enterprise Integration Architecture with focus on system integration patterns and platforms for the H&M Group as well as establishing an Integration Competence Center.
Developer for web and back-office applications for financial portfolio management.
